treatment_suggestions.title: Administer morphine for pain relief
treatment_suggestions.rationale: Patient reports chest pain with ST elevations on EKG, indicating potential STEMI. Morphine reduces preload and provides analgesia.

treatment_suggestions.title: Administer nitroglycerin
treatment_suggestions.rationale: To reduce preload and relieve chest pain in suspected STEMI. Patient showed no immediate response to initial nitroglycerin administration.

treatment_suggestions.title: Prepare for urgent transport to cath lab
treatment_suggestions.rationale: ST elevations on EKG suggest STEMI requiring immediate reperfusion therapy. Patient's condition warrants rapid transport to Danderyd Hospital for catheterization.

treatment_suggestions.title: Monitor vital signs and oxygen saturation
treatment_suggestions.rationale: Patient is diaphoretic and shows signs of potential myocardial ischemia. Continuous monitoring is essential for detecting changes in condition.

drafted_journal:
Situation: Bröstsmärta.
Bakgrund: Tryckande smärta i bröstet, ihållande. Debut i morse på jobbet. Mediciner: Atorvastatin och Losartan.
Socialt: Bor i Åkersberga.
Aktuellt: Vaken vid vår ankomst. Kallsvettig. Smärta 4/10. EKG visar ST-höjningar. Åtgärd: Ger morfin 2,5 mg och nitro. Skickar EKG till HIA.
Prehospitalt bedömt tillstånd: Misstänkt STEMI. Rekommendation: Transport till Danderyds sjukhus för kateterisering. Under transport: Fortsatt övervakning och syrgas vid behov.
